review_note: Read test and helpers line by line. Gaussian relmat(1 | id, Q = Q): exact Gaussian marginal N(X beta, sigma^2 I + Z K Z') in base R. Beta relmat K and Beta animal A: base-R dense Laplace with a hand Beta mean-precision density (phi = 1/sigma^2) whose eta-derivatives come from a five-point stencil; the hand Beta density is checked against stats::dbeta and a numerical integral of the zero-one-inflated variant in b31no_check_densities (which runs in the NB2 test file of this batch, not this file). Kernels hand-built (relmat D K D with diag in [0.8, 1.6]; Henderson A with inbreeding), supplied in reverse order. All three linked rows (Gaussian Q_precision, Beta K_covariance, Beta animal A_covariance) are q=1 independent structured intercepts fitted by exactly that route with sd(id, level=...) ~ w; the Q provider is compared against the hand K, so the precision handling is tested. Sensitivity asserted > 0.1 for reversed SD, flipped selector, K by position, K x2, cov2cor(K); observed min gaps 1.3 to 2.2 vs agreement ~1e-9. Hashes (test, helpers, sources, log, manifest, receipt) recompute; log 3 blocks, 33 expectations, 0 failures, 0 skips, 0 warnings; Totoro rerun reproduced 3/33/0/0/0. The ZeroOneBeta rows are correctly not claimed. Does NOT establish: ZeroOneBeta or any other family, REML behaviour, calibration, recovery, coverage, Julia parity, or more than one seed per route; the Beta density is hand-written so a shared misreading of the mean-precision parameterisation between hand density and package would be caught only by the dbeta check at the parameter level, not by an external package fit.
